en.headline: Hundreds attend Tai Po church mass marking Wang Fuk Court fire victims
en.dek: The Immaculate Heart of Mary Church held a service on Sunday in memory of lives lost over the year including those from the fire, as the first anniversary approaches.
body: Hundreds of people attended a mass at the Immaculate Heart of Mary Church in Tai Po on Sunday offered in memory of lives lost over the whole year and the deceased of the Wang Fuk Court fire.
The service came as the first anniversary of the blaze, which killed 168 people, approaches on 26 November. Cardinal Stephen Chow had earlier invited all parishes to hold special masses on that date.
The church had adjusted earlier announcements about the service following reports of inquiries. The diocese has described the masses as part of regular remembrance practices in November.

zh.headline: 大埔聖母無珨之心堂舉行追思彌撒 悼念全年亡者及宏福苑火災死難者
zh.dek: 周日數百人參與彌撒，紀念全年離世者包括宏福苑火災中的逝者，周年將至。
body: 大埔聖母無珨之心堂周日舉行彌撒，為全年已亡的兄弟姊妹及宏福苑火災死難者祈禱，數百人參與。
宏福苑火災造成168人死亡，周年將於11月26日。天主教香港教區主教周守仁早前已邀請全港堂區於當日舉行特別彌撒。
堂區早前調整相關公布。教區表示十一月為煉靈月，相關彌撒屬常規紀念。
